public_rationale: The forecast has no deadline, and the required funding-access failure has not been established. The available funding research describes continued investment despite a slowdown. Under the conditional-forecast rule, an unknown antecedent prevents scoring the revenue prediction. No decisive event was identified by October 28, 2026.
limitations: Aggregate funding trends do not establish the financing position of the relevant customers.
A permanent lack of future revenue loss cannot be inferred from a short observation period.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: If AI startups can no longer keep raising money, large chunks of OpenAI's and Anthropic's revenues will disappear.
conditions: if AI startups can no longer raise unlimited money

statement.excerpt: And if they can’t do that, large chunks of OpenAI and Anthropic’s revenues disappear.

our_interpretation: The antecedent is a sustained loss of fundraising access among the AI startup customers whose spending materially supports the two providers.
A decline in aggregate venture funding alone does not establish that those customers can no longer finance their spending.
Large chunks means a material loss of existing revenue at each provider, attributable to the affected customers. No numerical threshold or response time is supplied.
Revenue means realized revenue, not valuation, financing or an annualized run rate.
No accounting basis is specified for the future revenue comparison.
criteria.support_condition: After the specified customers lose continued fundraising access, matched customer and provider records show a material disappearance of their revenue contributions at both OpenAI and Anthropic.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent occurs and the affected customers have exhausted their financing runway, comparable records show their revenue contributions remain substantially intact. An arbitrary short observation window would not suffice.
